name: typewriter-stack
title: Typewriter Stack
description: Types and deletes successive phrases with a blinking caret, where typing speed varies per character (humanised), deletion is faster than typing, and the caret width adapts to the current glyph.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Medium
Shape: Sharp
Motion: Mechanical
Typography: Monospace
Color: Monochrome

## Rules

- Timer Cycle: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
